description:
## Goal

Make `ExecutableEffects(E)` an ordinary reactive per-executable product and delete its private reachability, SCC, snapshot, fixpoint, reverse-graph, and cone-invalidation machinery.

## Current defect

`produce_executable_effects` collects the reachable call cone, discovers SCCs, snapshots inputs, and settles a bespoke fixpoint. `PullSession` separately maintains `latest_effect_inputs`, `effect_dependents`, and manual reverse-cone invalidation. This is a batch pass embedded inside the product recalculator.

## Model

`ExecutableEffects(E)` reads E's local materialized effect and exact `ExecutableEffects(callee)` inputs. Generic pending-product cycle handling owns cycles. The effect join is idempotent OR/union, so a call SCC is the union of member-local and external effects; it does not need a separate algorithmic authority.

## TDD and signal

- Acyclic chain, self-cycle, mutual cycle, edge addition, edge removal, unchanged local projection, and changed leaf.
- Exact reverse dependents reevaluate; unreachable executables do not.
- Same product values, canonical causal work multiset, backend artifact, and runtime behavior.
- No cone collection, SCC discovery, snapshot replay, manual reverse effect graph, or end-session recomputation remains.
- Full library, fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, and clippy with warnings denied pass.

Delete `EffectGraph`, cone/SCC helpers, snapshot settlement, `latest_effect_inputs`, `effect_dependents`, `invalidate_effect_cone`, obsolete side inventory, tests that only prove the retired mini-pass, and documentation describing it.
title: Replace the executable-effect cone mini-compiler with reactive formulas
